# Generated by scripts/generate_rural_capacity_values.py for forest.
# Keep these values flat: EU5 displays scripted-value rows in building
# max-level tooltips, and nested helpers create confusing extra rows.

forest_capacity = {
	# Public remaining-capacity path for map modes and new-building gates.
	# Capacity buildings subtract their levels directly from this sum.
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FOREST"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_forest_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_forest_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = pp_forest_base_capacity_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_forest_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FOREST"
			value = var:pp_forest_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.040
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:forest_village }
		subtract = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_FOREST_VILLAGE"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:forest_village)"
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:managed_forest_village }
		subtract = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_MANAGED_FOREST_VILLAGE"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:managed_forest_village)"
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:lumber_mill }
		subtract = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_LUMBER_MILL"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:lumber_mill)"
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:water_sawmill }
		subtract = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_WATER_SAWMILL"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:water_sawmill)"
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:lumber_mill_improved }
		subtract = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_LUMBER_MILL_IMPROVED"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:lumber_mill_improved)"
		}
	}
	subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_URBANIZATION"
		value = total_building_levels
		multiply = 0.05
	}
}

# Per-building max-level paths. Each one is the same flat capacity sum
# but omits that building's own capacity-consumption row.
# Selected upgrade targets also omit replaceable lower-tier rows.

forest_capacity_max_forest_village = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FOREST"
		value = this.forest_capacity_max_forest_village_building_level_base_forest
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_forest_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FOREST"
			value = this.forest_capacity_max_forest_village_building_level_rgo_size_forest
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:managed_forest_village }
		subtract = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_MANAGED_FOREST_VILLAGE"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:managed_forest_village)"
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:lumber_mill }
		subtract = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_LUMBER_MILL"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:lumber_mill)"
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:water_sawmill }
		subtract = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_WATER_SAWMILL"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:water_sawmill)"
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:lumber_mill_improved }
		subtract = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_LUMBER_MILL_IMPROVED"
			value = "location_building_level(building_type:lumber_mill_improved)"
		}
	}
	subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FOREST_URBANIZATION"
		value = this.forest_capacity_max_forest_village_building_level_forest_urbanization
	}
}

# Tooltip helpers of forest_capacity_max_forest_village (cap_tooltips.py): each is one row of the cap, read through this.
forest_capacity_max_forest_village_building_level_base_forest = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_forest_base_capacity }
		value = var:pp_forest_base_capacity
	}
	else = { value = pp_forest_base_capacity_value }
}
